The small TXT, Markdown, and structured EPUB fixtures are original synthetic material dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0. The EPUB and its SVG illustration are reproducible with `node tools/fixtures.mjs`. They contain labelled paragraphs and sentinels for content, ordering, nested formatting, image, table, and endnote assertions. No private book belongs in this directory.

`publisher-alternatives.epub` is also original CC0 material, generated by the same command. It reproduces default EPUB versus hidden Kindle image alternatives, image-based chapter lettering, a full-color cover, source page labels before full-cell artwork, and intentional repeated illustrations. The opening audit checks single left-aligned headings, preserved image proportions and color, continuous body paragraphs, retained intentional alignment, no empty cells, and a title/info panel sharing a cell with source text.

`flourishes.epub` is original synthetic content generated by `node tools/flourish-fixture.mjs`: twenty uses of one small leaf drawing, with known paragraphs before and after each occurrence. It verifies bulk treatment, compact placement, aspect ratio, and independent overrides. No publisher artwork is included.
